mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_agent_revision_restore_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,agent_id,revision) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},CAST(#{agentId} AS bigint),#{revision}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,agent_id::text AS agent_id,revision FROM nw_agent_revision_restore_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
